reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin for selecting, uploading, and attaching arbitrary file types as mentions that the agent can access by resolved file location.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中选择或上传任意类型的文件，并将其作为供智能体读取的附件提及。
summaries.en: Attach files of any type in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI as mentions that the agent can read from their resolved locations.

capabilities: Lists workspace files for attachment selection
Accepts local file uploads through the web composer
Stores uploaded files in a private plugin directory
Resolves attachment mentions to file paths for agent tool access
Routes raster images through the built-in image pipeline
